Twin fibers C_Z have size ∏_{i∉Z}(q_i−1), and quotient D_r has automorphism S_r because vertex degrees identify singleton layer and adjacency to singletons recovers each subset. A stabilizer fixing a determining set can permute omitted twins, so at most one per fiber may be omitted. When any q_k>2, fibers complementary to nonbinary singleton, then mixed-pair complements, force each coordinate permutation trivial, giving sufficiency. Independent fiber choices yield factorized determining polynomial, minimum N−(2^r−2) and product multiplicity count. In all-Boolean case equal incidence columns permit coordinate transpositions and k rows give at most 2^k distinct columns; explicit binary labels attain ceil(log2 r).
